corpus.linearization: JPEG code values treated as IEC 61966-2-1 sRGB and inverse-EOTF decoded
corpus.selection: lexicographically first 100 train, 20 val, and 20 test filenames
corpus.terms: non-commercial research and educational use; cite Martin et al., ICCV 2001

m0.note: phase-centered affine LMMSE; mathematically equivalent to an unregularized constant column M3

gate_2_population_generalization.rule: retain at least half of source-oracle gain over geometry on the same strips

gate_4_held_out_benefit.rule: gain at least 1 dB over geometry and finish within 0.5 dB of corrected-final MLRI
